en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a coastal hillside landscape with several people sitting or standing among trees, overlooking the sea and distant landforms. The foreground features four figures resting on the grassy slope, with dense foliage leading down to the shoreline. There is printed decorative text in Italian and Greek/Latin characters, and extensive handwritten correspondence across the lower half. A circular postal cancellation mark is visible in the upper right area.
